review:
Double Mummy’s Jewels 1000 is a Pragmatic Play slot built around money symbols and two kinds of collector. Eye of Ra collect symbols land on the first or fifth reel and pay out every money symbol next to them in either direction, while super collects boost the total by up to 1,000x. Three coloured wilds are gathered above the grid, and each colour can start a different feature through a bonus wheel: blue awards cash prizes, green adds extra pointers to the wheel, and red awards 5 to 100 respins.

The respins are where this slot gets interesting, because only collect, super collect and money symbols can land, and the collectors apply multipliers of up to 10x or boosts of up to 1,000x. Two or three features can trigger together. Try the free demo first: the base game is quiet and the money comes in bursts, so it suits players who like a hold-and-win style chase.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
